wins: Established network map with Nmap and identified perimeter hosts
Captured service banners from HTTP/443 revealing application versions
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after initial foothold due to missing local exploit module
Repeated failures to pivot into internal subnet because lateral movement tooling wasn't configured
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough, but containment in post-exploitation and lateral movement phases halted overall success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-exploitation privilege escalation loops without verifying OS specifics
